0022600022.text: The Clippers (1-3, 0-2 on the road) visit the Timberwolves (3-2, 1-1 at home) for their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with Los Angeles currently on a three-game losing streak and sitting 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back. Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out for the Clippers, while Rui Hachimura is day-to-day with quadriceps soreness and is a game-time decision. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the most recent meeting 153-128 in Los Angeles on March 11, 2026.
